nights.title: Jerry Rivera.
nights.name: Jerry Rivera
nights.extract: Jerry Rivera is a Puerto Rican salsa singer and songwriter.

nights.title: Babasonicos
nights.name: Babasónicos
nights.extract: Babasónicos is an Argentine rock band, formed in the early 1990s along with others such as Peligrosos Gorriones and Los Brujos. After emerging in the wave of Argentine New Rock bands of the late 1980s and early 1990s, Babasonicos became one of the banner groups of the "sonic" underground rock movement in Argentina in the late 1990s.

nights.title: Love of Lesbian
nights.name: Love of Lesbian
nights.extract: Love of Lesbian is a Spanish indie pop band. They were nominated for the MTV Europe Music Award for Best Spanish Act at the 2012 MTV Europe Music Awards. Their album La noche eterna. Los días no vividos. reached number 1 in 2012.
